yt.title: How to find 1 name in 1 billion in {c_steps} steps #Shorts
yt.description:
Binary search halves a sorted list each step: ceil(log2(1,000,000,000)) = {c_steps}.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: How many checks does it take to find one name among a billion?

scenes.label: to find one item in a sorted list of 1 billion
scenes.narration: Checking one by one could take a billion steps. But in a sorted list, you can cut it in half every time. That takes at most {c_steps_say} steps.
This is binary search. Each check throws away half of what is left.
